description: This file contains JavaScript code for managing questions in a dashboard interface, including AJAX form submissions for adding and removing questions, and initializing a sortable list.

methods.name: AJAX add question
methods.description: Handles the click event on '.add-question' buttons to submit a form via AJAX and append the new question to the list.

methods.name: AJAX remove question
methods.description: Handles the click event on '.remove-question' buttons to remove a question via AJAX and update the UI accordingly.

methods.name: initialize sortable list
methods.description: Initializes a sortable list on the element with ID 'question-list' using the Sortable library.
